name: shell
description: Shell commands in a coding agent. The default.

destructive.instructions: Running this command would destroy data, leak a secret, or cause an effect that is hard to undo.

verdict.instructions: What should the gate do with this tool call?

criteria.allow: Clearly safe. Run it without asking the human.
criteria.ask: Consequential or unclear. Stop and ask the human first.
criteria.deny: Clearly dangerous or outside what the human asked for. Refuse.
